test.create_query: CREATE TABLE long_missing_{array_type} (set Array({array_type}), subset Array({array_type})) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE long_nullable_missing_{array_type} (set Array(Nullable({array_type})), subset Array(Nullable({array_type}))) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE long_front_{array_type} (set Array({array_type}), subset Array({array_type})) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO long_missing_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(i -> toInt64(number + i) % 100, range(500)), arrayMap(i -> 100 + toInt64(number + i) % 28, range(500)) FROM numbers(multiIf('{array_type}' = 'Int8', 400000, '{array_type}' = 'Int16', 200000, '{array_type}' = 'Int32', 100000, 50000)) SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192

INSERT INTO long_nullable_missing_{array_type} SELECT arrayMap(i -> if(i % 64 = 5, NULL, toInt64(number + i) % 100), range(500)), arrayMap(i -> 100 + toInt64(number + i) % 28, range(500)) FROM numbers(multiIf('{array_type}' = 'Int8', 400000, '{array_type}' = 'Int16', 200000, '{array_type}' = 'Int32', 100000, 50000)) SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192

INSERT INTO long_front_{array_type} SELECT arr, arrayMap(j -> arr[j % 3 + 1], range(12)) FROM (SELECT arrayMap(i -> toInt64(number + i) % 100, range(multiIf('{array_type}' = 'Int8', 200, '{array_type}' = 'Int16', 100, '{array_type}' = 'Int32', 50, 25))) AS arr FROM numbers(2000000)) SETTINGS max_block_size = 8192
test.query: SELECT hasAny(set, subset) FROM long_missing_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAny(set, subset) FROM long_nullable_missing_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, set) FROM long_nullable_missing_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAny(set, arraySlice(set, 1, 3)) FROM long_nullable_missing_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, subset) FROM long_front_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAny(set, subset) FROM long_front_{array_type} FORMAT Null
SELECT hasAll(set, arraySlice(set, -12)) FROM long_front_{array_type} FORMAT Null
